blocks.text: For 30 years, Secosana has been part of the Filipina’s journey, offering stylish and accessible bags for life’s everyday moments and special occasions. On October 22, the homegrown brand celebrates this milestone with a new anniversary collection that honors its legacy while taking an exciting step into the future. For the first time in its history, Secosana expands into footwear, introducing a new category alongside its latest bag styles. Designed for the many occasions that make up a woman’s day, the footwear transitions effortlessly from workdays and everyday errands to special dinners and celebrations.
